hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Cross-asset regime is risk-on, but the risk budget should remain reduced: institutional advisory risk is elevated, expected shortfall is material for BTC/ETH/SOL/LTC, and most altcoin signals appear mechanically identical with zero volatility, expected-shortfall, liquidity, and institutional-factor inputs. BTC is the only relatively well-supported signal. ETH and SOL are marginal, while LTC is appropriately flat. Fragile signals: XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC due to incomplete or non-discriminating risk data; their long verdicts should not be treated as reliable conviction
